thread:
jamie: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up: can leadership clarify the timelines for API improvements, Console dashboards, and Optimize recommendations? A few customers asked for concrete beta/GA dates.

ana: Short answer: yes — high level timelines in this thread. I'll drop an internal roadmap doc by EOD.

leon: For the Redwood API surface (streaming + function calling polish): target public beta in ~6 weeks, GA end of Q2. Working plan: beta for existing users first, then open beta.

sasha: Console timeline: per-route dashboards + token-level cost drilldown -> beta in 5 weeks, GA in ~10 weeks. We'll ship a minimal UI first (usage + latency) then add tracing links.

mira: Optimize (batching + cache suggestions): lab-preview next week for a handful of customers, broader beta in 7 weeks. The ML heuristics still need one more iteration on cold-start latency.

toni: Engineering note: the runtime perf targets for GA are still tied to a few kernel fixes. If those land on schedule we hit the promised 1.2x throughput improvement; if not we degrade the GA timeline by 2w. Keeping everyone posted.

alex: PMM request: we need a single slide deck summarizing beta criteria + customer opt-in flow. Anyone volunteering to own?

leon: I can own the API slide and the opt-in wording.

ana: I'll take console and Optimize bullets; alex pls coordinate.

jamie: Thanks — can you be explicit about dates we can tell customers? Some asked about onboarding in July.

leon: Concrete dates (tentative): API beta start 1768219200 (Fri, 2026-05-13 UTC), GA 1768972800 (Tue, 2026-06-23 UTC). Beta only for existing accounts for 2 weeks, then opt-in open.

sasha: Console beta: 1768128000 (Tue, 2026-05-01 UTC) — internal plus early access. Console GA: 1769568000 (Mon, 2026-07-06 UTC).

mira: Optimize preview: 1768000000 (Mon, 2026-04-20 UTC) for 10 customers. Broader beta: 1768704000 (Tue, 2026-06-17 UTC).

toni: Re: SLAs for Dedicated — we still require a final legal/ops review. That may slip the Dedicated SLA offering to after these GA dates by ~3 weeks.

jamie: OK — call that out when communicating to customers so expectations are set.

leon: Also: migration notes. For apps using older streaming heuristics, we'll provide a small config flag to opt-in to the new streaming behavior. Example: `X-Redwood-Stream: beta-v2`. We'll include sample curl + SDK snippets.

mira: Good — Optimize will surface a suggested config diff in the Console UI too (one-click apply).

sasha: Ops detail: we'll enable canary rollouts by model and by customer tier. Default canary = 5% traffic for 48h, auto-rollback on >2% error spike. I'll post the exact policy in #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-controller v2 -> staging at 1767870000

toni: Perf testing plan: we need owners for the benchmark matrix (sequence lengths, batch sizes). @mira @sasha can you take that?

mira: Yep, I'll own seq len 32/128/512 workstreams.

sasha: I'll own cluster-level and failover tests.

alex: Marketing note: we should freeze messaging two weeks before GA. I'll sync w/ana on exact copy.

ana: Will do. Also adding an FAQ about billing: Optimize suggestions don't change billing unless customer applies quantization or config changes; we'll call that out.

jamie: Action items summary: 1) ana to publish internal roadmap doc EOD, 2) leon/mira/sasha to confirm perf benchmarks in 2 weeks, 3) alex to prepare slide deck + freeze messaging 2w before each GA, 4) toni to confirm Dedicated SLA schedule. If anyone needs to update dates, please ping here.

leon: Noted. I'll post an API beta signup form once infra is ready.

mira: I'll share Optimize preview invite list today.

sasha: I'll post canary policy + rollout runbook to #eng-oncall by tomorrow.

ana: Thanks all. We'll send a short customer-facing email next week with tentative dates and the opt-in links.

jamie: Perfect — appreciate the quick follow-up. :thumbsup:
